_comment: ADOPT: which provider this institution chose for each role in adapters/providers/roles.json. This file is the middle link the Loom was missing: profiles say a capability is REQUIRED, the adapter contract says how a chosen system reports EVIDENCE, and until now nothing recorded WHICH system was chosen — the choice was implicit in whichever file happened to sit in a directory. Selecting is not installing: the chosen provider's adapter must also be copied to docs/governance/adapters/, and it stays 'selected, not active' until its activation_evidence carries a real fetch and a passed negative probe. Ground each decision in an approved source (institution/brainkit/source-register.json), the same way technology-policy.json does. Validated by scripts/provider-selection-check.mjs.
